event_properties.content: How is my staff being mentioned in reviews?

Staff mentions are **mostly positive** this month (74% positive). "Helpful", "friendly", and "attentive" are the most common words. Negative staff mentions (26%) centre around one outlet — **Brigade Road** — with 9 guests mentioning a rushed experience.
What do customers say about our packaging?

Packaging gets mentioned in **31 reviews** this month. 22 are positive — customers like the eco-friendly boxes. 9 are negative — mostly that the biryani container leaks during delivery. Worth flagging to your packaging vendor.
